claims.author: winterrdog
claims.harm: On platforms where char is signed, non-ASCII UTF-8 bytes wrap to negative values and match c < 0x20, causing valid UTF-8 paths like /tmp/josé.sock to be replaced with "unix" in logs.
claims.quote: char is signed on some platforms (e.g. x86), so bytes above 0x7f are interpreted as negative values (they wrap around) and also match c < 0x20. this means a utf-8 path like /tmp/josé.sock could end up being replaced with "unix" in the logs

claims.request: Log host instead of strRPCBind in the bind failure warning to avoid redundant port strings when a port is included in the address.
